mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_explosion_analysis ( task_id, user_id, conversation_id, snapshot_date, scoring_version, council_version, time_window_days, top_n, item_count, goal_mode, focus_slots, plan_degraded, focus_count, summary, header_json ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{scoringVersion}, #{councilVersion}, #{timeWindowDays}, #{topN}, #{itemCount}, #{goalMode}, #{focusSlots}, #{planDegraded}, #{focusCount}, #{summary}, #{headerJson} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), conversation_id = VALUES(conversation_id), snapshot_date = VALUES(snapshot_date), scoring_version = VALUES(scoring_version), council_version = VALUES(council_version), time_window_days = VALUES(time_window_days), top_n = VALUES(top_n), item_count = VALUES(item_count), goal_mode = VALUES(goal_mode), focus_slots = VALUES(focus_slots), plan_degraded = VALUES(plan_degraded), focus_count = VALUES(focus_count), summary = VALUES(summary), header_json = VALUES(header_json)

INSERT INTO ai_explosion_item ( task_id, sku_id, rank_no, explosion_score, action_bucket, primary_action, in_focus_slot, quality_risk_level, feature_excerpt, council_excerpt, ai_reason ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{skuId}, #{rankNo}, #{score}, #{bucket}, #{action}, #{inSlot}, #{risk}, #{excerpt}, #{council}, #{reason} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rank_no = VALUES(rank_no), explosion_score = VALUES(explosion_score), action_bucket = VALUES(action_bucket), primary_action = VALUES(primary_action), in_focus_slot = VALUES(in_focus_slot), quality_risk_level = VALUES(quality_risk_level), feature_excerpt = VALUES(feature_excerpt), council_excerpt = VALUES(council_excerpt), ai_reason = VALUES(ai_reason)
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, user_id, conversation_id, snapshot_date, scoring_version, council_version, time_window_days, top_n, item_count, goal_mode, focus_slots, plan_degraded, focus_count, summary, header_json, created_at FROM ai_explosion_analysis WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR user_id IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT sku_id, rank_no, explosion_score, action_bucket, primary_action, in_focus_slot, quality_risk_level, feature_excerpt, council_excerpt, ai_reason FROM ai_explosion_item WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY rank_no IS NULL, rank_no ASC
